verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents Domain Sending Keys, API keys restricted to POST on /messages and /messages.mime for a single domain. That gives a genuine least-privilege credential for a send-only agent. No other scope granularity is evidenced, so an agent doing the broader MCP tasks (stats, domain management, DNS troubleshooting) would apparently need a full-privilege key. Missing for 10: scopes beyond send-only (e.g., read-only analytics or per-resource permissions), guidance on credentials for MCP or agent use, key expiry/rotation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
